text_block_list.text: Нарита Брайан and I are visiting a shrine.

Hey, do we really need to ask the gods
for help at
this point?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I've been worried about Нарита Брайан's
condition
recently, so I tell her that I'd
like to pray for her
health.

...You know, it's my responsibility to
take care of
myself. Not the gods' or
Buddha's.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: I just want to do whatever I can.

text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. Fine, if you're going to insist.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I pray for Нарита Брайан's speedy recovery.
...Okay, let's go.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I didn't pray for anything.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I just went along with it to make you feel
better.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Sorry to make you do that...

text_block_list.text:
No matter. It's just a difference in
customs. But, I
will say this...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You're the only one in charge of your
own body.
Victory is something you've
got to take for
yourself.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It's not the gods that are going to
answer your
prayers...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: It's me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hmph. If you got it, then let's go.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Although... I have to admit, there is a
nice breeze
here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling pretty good. How about a
quick run
before going back?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Huh... The wind smells damp...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I don't like it...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Rumble, rumble... Drip drop...
Agh! It's raining!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Tch! Let's hurry back!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Perhaps we displeased the gods?

Perhaps it's just the nice change of pace,
but

in her stЭпизод

Drenched by the rain, Нарита Брайан
doesn't say
another word the whole way
back.
